title: Lease store: per-resource epoch lease records
action: New module lease-store.mjs: records under .bee/runtime/leases/cells/<cell-id>.json and .bee/runtime/leases/paths/<path-hash>.json with {resource, mode, workflow_id, session_id, workspace_id, epoch, acquired_at, expires_at}. Acquire = canonicalize paths, sort by hash (deadlock-free), O_EXCL-create each lease, roll back already-acquired leases on partial failure. Release, renew, sweep-expired per-record — no whole-store lock, no whole-file rewrites. Session-free structural isolation like workflow-store (C4 pattern). Placement note: .bee/runtime/ now; slice 4 re-roots under controlRoot. Regen inside this cell after the code change: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write (+ impact_registry --write if suites changed). Canonical source: skills/bee-hive/templates/ (vendored to .bee/bin/ + plugin mirrors).

truths: hash-sorted multi-path acquire is deadlock-free (test with reversed request order)

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check
